description: Statically inventory EVM contract bytecode (ADR-0005): instruction and JUMPDEST counts, function selectors recognized from the dispatcher (with names for a small well-known table only), counts and offsets of hazardous opcodes (SELFDESTRUCT, DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE, CREATE/CREATE2, ORIGIN, CALL, STATICCALL), embedded addresses, event topics, EIP-1167 minimal-proxy detection, compiler metadata, and embedded strings such as revert reasons (AIDefence-screened). Pass bytecode inline as hex, or a path to a file of hex text or raw bytes. Aligned disassembly only: there is no EVM interpreter, no RPC, and no network. Use when you need the exposed surface and risky capabilities of a contract before deeper review; a hazardous opcode is an inventory fact, not a vulnerability finding, and dispatcher detection can miss unusual layouts.

bytecode.description: Contract bytecode as hex (0x prefix optional). Provide this or path, not both.

includeDisassembly.description: Also return the first 500 instructions (default false)

path.description: Absolute path to a file containing hex text or raw bytecode

name: rure_analyze_evm
